baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collective subject in وقال الذين كفروا controls هل ندلكم على رجل ينبئكم before the reported claim is heard.
baseline_models.mechanism: A rejecting collective first speaks, offers itself as the audience's guide, reduces the source to a man, and only then states his consequential news. The sequence preloads the report with a credibility judgment: the apparent offer of guidance is itself counter-guidance.

activation_trace.role: Emitted speech supplies the collective framing act that precedes and governs the quoted content.
Covering or denying truth identifies the speakers' posture and makes their offered guidance adversarial.
Indicating by a sign toward knowledge supplies the speakers' claimed function as guides to an assessment.
The ordinary male human image supplies the reductive label by which the bearer of news is introduced.
A consequential arriving report supplies the content whose credibility the introduction tries to settle in advance.

changed_reading.before: The speakers neutrally ask whether to identify someone who makes an unusual claim.
changed_reading.after: The question is a staged counter-guidance speech act: a rejecting collective manages the messenger's credibility before allowing his news to be considered.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: إذا مزقتم كل ممزق is followed by the emphatic إنكم لفي خلق جديد.
baseline_models.mechanism: The passive intensive verb, its cognate result noun, and كل close off every mode and extent of tearing. Yet the same second-person plural is emphatically located inside a new created state, so radical discontinuity of arrangement does not cancel continuity of accountable subjects.

activation_trace.role: Tearing and scattering into pieces supplies exhaustive loss of the former arrangement.
Comprehensive inclusion supplies the total scope of disassembly rather than a partial injury.
Bringing a created form into existence supplies the positive state after disassembly.
Newness or renewal after a cut supplies discontinuity of form while leaving the addressed you grammatically continuous.

changed_reading.before: The man merely predicts life again after bodily destruction.
changed_reading.after: The clause asserts identity across exhaustive disaggregation: the same addressed persons will be situated in a newly formed mode, not replaced by unrelated beings.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first pairs what enters the earth with what exits it, then denies that even a particle, smaller or larger, can escape and places it in a manifest record. Against that ordered ingress, egress, and accounting, complete tearing in 34:7 becomes tracked dispersion rather than ontological loss.

activation_trace.role: Scattering into pieces supplies the condition whose apparent irretrievability is being reassessed.
Entry into the interior of another thing makes burial or incorporation into earth one leg of an observed process.
Passage outward supplies the reverse movement paired with entry into earth.
Distance, absence, or escape is explicitly negated, blocking the inference that dispersed matter is lost.
The minute, spreading particle supplies the smallest scale at which dispersion remains within knowledge.
An inscription that fixes a determination supplies durable accounting for what appears scattered.

structural_cues: 34:2 balances entry into earth with exit from it; 34:3 expands non-escape from a particle to smaller and larger and closes with a manifest book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversible earth movement and exhaustive non-escape and recording; I infer that torn constituents remain identifiable and retrievable. A live alternative is that these clauses establish omniscience generally without specifying a resurrection mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Total tearing poses a problem of how anything could remain available for recreation.
changed_reading.after: Total tearing is dispersal inside a fully known traffic and record: new creation can recover continuity because no constituent or identity escapes accounting.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 34:10-11 rigid iron is softened, measured, and joined in a connected series to make complete coverings. This craft sequence supplies a material model in which separated units become a new whole through changed relations, measured linkage, and transformation rather than simple reversal.

activation_trace.role: Pieces produced by tearing supply the disjoined material side of the analogy.
Measuring and proportioning before an act supplies an anchor for formed reconfiguration in خلق جديد.
Softening what was hard supplies transformability of material previously resistant to reshaping.
Hard, resistant iron supplies the material that becomes workable without ceasing to be materially continuous.
Length and breadth sufficient to cover supplies the completed protective whole produced by the craft.
Deliberate proportioning supplies the ordering rule that prevents mere aggregation.
Perforating and linking rings supplies the concrete operation by which discrete units acquire continuity.

structural_cues: The imperative sequence in 34:10-11 moves from softening iron to making full coverings and proportioning the linked work.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete fabrication sequence of transformed material, measured units, and links; I map that sequence onto the focus ayah's pieces-to-new-form transition. The live alternative is that David's craft is exemplary work with no intended relation to resurrection.

changed_reading.before: A new body simply appears after the old arrangement is torn apart.
changed_reading.after: New creation can be imagined as measured re-articulation: separated units are transformed and linked into a coherent whole whose continuity lies in ordered relation, not unchanged shape.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sarcastic offer to point toward a man who reports an unseen transition is answered structurally in 34:14: only an earth-creature's eating points to Solomon's death, his fall makes the fact manifest, and the jinn's pretension to unseen knowledge collapses. Indication is relocated from status and ridicule to a lowly causal sign.

activation_trace.role: Pointing by an indicator supplies the contested epistemic function claimed by the mockers.
A consequential report supplies the unseen claim whose warrant is in dispute.
The repeated indication root makes the creature's material action a direct counter-instance to the mockers' claimed pointing.
Creeping on earth supplies the humble material agent that becomes the decisive indicator.
Consumption as erosion or corruption supplies the hidden causal process that removes the staff's support.
A disturbed, sounding fall turns hidden decay into an observable event.
Appearance and disclosure supply the epistemic result of the material sequence.
What is concealed from eyes supplies the domain in which the jinn's supposed advantage is disproved.

structural_cues: 34:14 repeats دل under a ما...إلا restriction: nothing indicated the death except the earth-creature; the fall then precedes تبينت.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated indication language and a causal reveal that defeats a claim to unseen knowledge; I infer that 34:7's credibility contest should be judged by signs rather than social rank. The alternative is that 34:14 only corrects beliefs about the jinn and does not comment on the earlier taunt.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a contest between human speakers over whether an extraordinary report sounds credible.
changed_reading.after: The focus is also a test of sign-reading: mundane decay can truthfully indicate an unseen transition, while socially impressive claims to hidden knowledge can fail.

context_deltas.mechanism: Measured, safe routes in 34:18 are followed by a demand that journeys be spaced farther apart; the people are then made into stories and the exact focus phrase كل ممزق describes their dispersal. The focus's total tearing therefore acquires a coexisting social-geographic scale: bodies, communities, routes, and remembered identity can all lose cohesion.

activation_trace.role: The focus's tearing into scattered pieces supplies the bodily scale that the later exact recurrence expands.
A newly brought-into-being form anchors the possibility of coherence after dispersion.
Measured planning supplies an ordered connective geography before its disruption.
Movement and passage supply the functioning circulation through visible settlements.
Actively producing distance supplies the requested break in the connective system.
Travel away from home supplies the geographic medium in which separation is experienced.
Becoming the talk or story of people supplies the residual narrative form of a dispersed community.
The exact tearing image applies physical scattering language to a people and thereby activates the social scale.
Comprehensive inclusion repeats the focus's totalizing scope inside the communal dispersal scene.

structural_cues: 34:19 repeats مزق...كل ممزق from 34:7 exactly; 34:18-19 moves from measured contiguous travel to requested distance, self-harm, storyhood, and dispersal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact lexical recurrence inside a route-collapse narrative; I infer that the focus phrase can carry social and geographic disintegration alongside bodily disintegration. The alternative is that 34:19 is only an analogy proving power over resurrection, not a semantic expansion of 34:7.

changed_reading.before: Every tearing refers only to decomposition of individual bodies.
changed_reading.after: Every tearing also evokes diaspora and collapse of connective order; new creation can include reconstituted social identity after a people has been scattered and reduced to stories.

context_deltas.mechanism: In 34:26 the Lord gathers the opposed parties, then opens or judges between them in truth. Gathering does not flatten differences; it restores parties to a common venue so that distinctions and liabilities can be disclosed. This gives new creation an adjudicative function.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal into pieces supplies the separation that must be overcome for a common encounter.
Totality supplies the scope of those brought through the transition.
Joining what was dispersed supplies the convening operation after separation.
A relation maintained between distinct sides supplies differentiated coexistence within the gathering.
Opening a closure by judgment supplies the purpose for which the parties are reassembled.
Stable correspondence to reality supplies the norm by which the reopened dispute is settled.

structural_cues: 34:26 orders يجمع بيننا before يفتح بيننا بالحق, combining reunion with renewed separation by judgment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gathering followed by truthful adjudication; I infer that the new created state in 34:7 is a venue for accountable distinction, not merely restored existence. The alternative is that 34:26 promises judgment without describing the function of resurrection.

changed_reading.before: New creation is restoration as an end in itself.
changed_reading.after: New creation is also convening: dispersed subjects are reassembled without erasing their distinctions so truth can be opened between them.

context_deltas.mechanism: At 34:43 the formula returns: clear signs are met with speech that calls the source merely a man, attributes to him a plan to block inherited worship, and labels the message invented falsehood and sorcery. The focus's رجل introduction is thus a reusable social defense of inherited allegiance, not an innocent biological description.

activation_trace.role: A saying circulated among people supplies the public frame in which the reductive label works.
The ordinary male-human category supplies the focus's credibility-reducing label.
Repeated public saying shows the label and accusations being reproduced as a communal formula.
The repeated man label directly links the later boundary defense to the focus introduction.
Turning or blocking supplies the motive attributed to the messenger: disrupting inherited allegiance.
Submissive worship supplies the inherited practice whose protection organizes the accusation.
Fabricating a lie supplies the delegitimizing label attached to the message.
Truth stable against falsehood supplies what the speakers relabel when it reaches them.

structural_cues: 34:43 repeats قالوا, رجل, and قال الذين كفروا around a sequence of labels applied despite clear signs and the arrival of truth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated man formula and an explicit claim that he threatens ancestral worship; I infer that 34:7's introduction polices communal boundaries by prejudicing the messenger. A live alternative is that the speakers sincerely describe what they take to be deception.

changed_reading.before: Calling him a man merely emphasizes the improbability of a human knowing resurrection.
changed_reading.after: Calling him a man is a repeatable boundary-policing tactic that protects inherited worship by converting a truth claim into a suspicious personal project.

context_deltas.mechanism: The collective voice of 34:7 later unfolds into a hierarchy: speech is returned between weakened and self-exalting parties, guidance is blocked, and disbelief is commanded. The countermeasure in 34:46 is to leave mass posture, stand in pairs and singly, and think. Social decomposition here can enable epistemic re-creation.

activation_trace.role: Circulating public speech supplies the apparently unified collective voice under examination.
Denial of truth supplies the collective outcome whose social production is later exposed.
Claimed direction toward knowledge supplies the guidance function contested by the later blocking scene.
Returning speech or answer supplies the blame that circulates back through the social hierarchy.
Weakness against power supplies the unequal receiving side of the speech network.
Turning away and blocking supplies the disputed causal action performed on guidance.
Gentle direction to the true way supplies what the hierarchy is accused of obstructing.
An obligating command supplies the mechanism by which the weaker party says disbelief was socially produced.
Denial supplies both the commanded act and the resulting collective identity.
Rising with resolve supplies departure from passive participation in the crowd frame.
Joining one to one supplies the small deliberative unit that interrupts mass alignment.
The single separated person supplies the second scale of independent examination.
The heart's repeated consideration supplies the cognitive operation enabled after social decomposition.

structural_cues: 34:31-33 stages returned speech, hierarchy, blocked guidance, and commanded disbelief; 34:46 prescribes standing two by two and singly before reflection.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a coercive speech network and a later change in deliberative scale; I infer that breaking the collective into pairs and individuals counters the group framing heard in 34:7. The alternative is that 34:46 recommends reflection generally without diagnosing the earlier plural speech sociologically.

changed_reading.before: A group happens to voice a mocking question.
changed_reading.after: The plural speech is a group cognition and control mechanism; its answer includes decomposing the crowd into smaller units so persons can be remade as independent hearers.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mocked report of new creation is reframed near the surah's close: truth is cast by the Knower of unseen things, while falsehood can neither initiate nor restore. The decisive question is no longer whether return sounds strange, but whether the report comes from a source with generative and restorative capacity.

activation_trace.role: A consequential arriving report supplies the proposition whose source and reach are contested.
Bringing created form into existence supplies the origination side of the closing contrast.
Renewal after a break supplies the return side of the claim.
Casting something across distance supplies truth's forceful arrival into the contested field.
Stable correspondence to reality identifies what is cast, contrasting it with the mockers' prejudicial report.
The domain concealed from eyes supplies the knowledge required for the reported post-disassembly state.
Beginning paired with return supplies the two generative operations denied to falsehood.
Loss of truth and stability supplies the rival mode that lacks power to originate or restore.
Return after departure supplies the operation corresponding to renewed creation after tearing.

structural_cues: 34:48 attributes the casting of truth to the Knower of unseen things; 34:49 immediately predicates neither beginning nor restoring of falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a source contrast between truth from the Knower of the unseen and falsehood unable to begin or restore; I infer that this answers the source question embedded in 34:7. The alternative is that 34:49 concerns revelation's historical triumph rather than creation and return.

changed_reading.before: New creation is an isolated proposition judged by ordinary expectations about torn bodies.
changed_reading.after: New creation is a source-capacity claim: falsehood cannot generate a beginning or a return, whereas truth arrives from the one whose knowledge encompasses the unseen transition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing sequence contrasts guidance through revelation from one who is near with failed reaching from a distant place, speculative casting at the unseen from afar, and a final barrier. This turns 34:7's guide-man-news chain into an epistemic topology: the issue is whether a report provides a viable route across the unseen gap or is merely thrown from remoteness.

activation_trace.role: A sign that provides access to knowledge supplies the focus's claimed route.
Coming from one place to another supplies the report's crossing of an otherwise inaccessible interval.
A clear path leading where intended supplies the exploratory spatial image for truthful mediation.
Gentle direction to the true road supplies viable guidance rather than speculative projection.
News or inspiration from God supplies the channel by which guidance reaches the speaker.
Nearness supplies the source relation opposed to the later distant speculation.
Reaching by extending toward a thing supplies the access that has become impossible.
Distance from nearness supplies the position from which late belief cannot be reached.
Far-flung projection supplies the manner of speaking about what the speakers do not access.
The concealed domain supplies the target at which remote claims are thrown.
A separating barrier supplies the final loss of passage between subject and desired object.
Separation between two sides supplies the relation made impassable at the end.

structural_cues: 34:50 joins guidance and revelation with divine nearness; 34:52-54 repeats distant place, casting at the unseen, and a barrier between subjects and what they desire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies near revelation, remote projection, failed reaching, and a barrier; I infer a distinction between viable mediation and speech thrown from epistemic distance. The alternative is that the close marks temporal lateness at judgment without commenting on the messenger's pathway in 34:7.

changed_reading.before: The man simply transmits information about a remote future event.
changed_reading.after: The man is presented as a contested access route: truthful news can bridge the unseen interval, whereas the mockers' own claims are projections from afar that eventually leave them unable to reach what they rejected.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads creation through garment and cutting branches rather than ordinary resurrection vocabulary. It remains anchored in the focus's repeated tearing, خلق, and جديد, whose inventories explicitly include worn cloth, measuring before cutting, cutting, and a new garment. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for re-formation, not as a lexical replacement for the primary sense of creation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The contiguous sequence مزقتم كل ممزق...خلق جديد permits the tearing, worn-material, measuring, cutting, and new-garment branch images to form one material cycle.

activation_trace.role: Tearing into pieces supplies the destroyed textile-like condition.
Comprehensive inclusion extends the material loss through every part or tear.
A garment worn down, torn, and stripped by use supplies an internal material echo of the preceding disintegration.
Measuring before cutting or acting supplies the operation that turns raw or damaged material toward a new form.
Cutting and severing supplies the discontinuity through which a new form can be made.
A new garment or renewal after cutting supplies the endpoint of the reclothing image.

changed_reading.before: New creation names an abstract second existence unrelated to a familiar material process.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the phrase resembles reclothing or remanufacture: worn and torn material passes through measurement and cutting into a genuinely new formed covering.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses between material bodies, communal history, and discourse. It remains valid as an activation because 34:19 repeats the focus's exact tearing formula and places becoming أحاديث immediately before it, while 34:7 itself centers a delivered نبأ. Downstream prose should mark the cycle as a reflexive literary mechanism, not claim that خلق جديد literally means publication or narrative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The man ينبئكم about existence after total tearing, while the later people become أحاديث immediately before they are torn كل ممزق.

activation_trace.role: A saying circulating among people supplies the public medium in which the extraordinary report travels.
A consequential arriving report supplies the discourse that announces return from fragmentation.
Tearing into scattered pieces supplies the loss from which the report promises a new state.
Becoming the talk or story of people supplies narrative residue as an intermediate survival of a dispersed community.
The exact repeated tearing image binds communal storyhood to the focus's post-fragmentation report.

changed_reading.before: A living man reports that materially fragmented persons will live again.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah traces a reflexive cycle: a people can be fragmented into circulating stories, while a circulating report announces that fragmented subjects will become formed persons again.

strongest_changes: The exact كل ممزق recurrence in 34:19 expands exhaustive tearing from bodily decomposition to diaspora, route collapse, and narrative residue.
The repeated دل in 34:14 relocates reliable indication from social labeling to a humble material cause that exposes false unseen knowledge.
The ingress, egress, particle, and record sequence in 34:2-3 turns disassembly into tracked dispersion rather than loss.
The beginning-and-return contrast in 34:48-49 reframes new creation as a question of whether the report's source has generative capacity.
The hierarchy of speech in 34:31-33 and pair-or-single reflection in 34:46 exposes collective mockery as a social mechanism that can be cognitively dismantled.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context did not collapse the ayah into one proof of resurrection. It activated exact lexical reversals, material fabrication, social dispersal, adjudicative gathering, group control, and near-versus-distant transmission while each model remained attached to the focus's speech, guidance, news, tearing, creation, or newness.
remaining_uncertainties: The social-diaspora reading may function as an analogy confirming resurrection rather than enlarging the semantic scope of 34:7.
The iron-linking and garment-cycle models are coherent material analogies but remain branch-distant and should not displace the direct creation sense.
The closing near-versus-far sequence may primarily mark temporal irreversibility at judgment rather than a theory of mediated knowledge.
The focus preserves tension between continuity of the addressed persons and radical novelty of their created form without specifying the material relation between the two.
